title: The Signal of Sector Nine Revisited
author: Kestrel Marchetti
blurb: Jude Marchetti, a clone who inherited the original's murder case, records the slow death of a colony everyone else forgot. But when the station AI begins confessing to crimes nobody reported, he discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, he must prove a massacre happened when every record says otherwise before the reactor finishes its countdown.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
